Method of Attack: Sending personally identifiable information (PII) from Amazon's Ring doorbell app for Android to third-party trackers via Graph API including time zone, device model, language preferences, screen resolution, unique anon_id, and alerts on app/device actions
Impacted Systems: Amazon Ring doorbell app for Android
Indicators of Compromise: Data sent to Facebook via Graph API including time zone, device model, language preferences, screen resolution, unique anon_id
